scope.method: Read-only: for each official load_state item, compare voting.json + extraction evidence (ballot id, source path/time/quote), dossier.json per-day night attack/deaths/exile/self-destruct, review_record.json including corrections/recap, and recap_original.txt. A game day is anchored to source narrative and dossier round events; ballot sequence/number is not treated as game day. Suggestions are limited to direct, high-confidence correspondences.

rule_context.treasure_master: 按用户确认：S22盗宝大师全局保持狼人阵营，不因选牌变成好人；其他小狼出局后仍可代表狼队带刀。此规则作为审查背景，不通过 guessed faction switch 重解释死亡/投票。
rule_context.preserve_transcripts: 所有原始转写及已有档案均未改动；报告只引用路径、时间和短摘录。
